message: You're still peddling the same tired lies, aren't you? Claiming to be a champion of the unborn, but really just a pawn in the game of conservative politics. You're not even an original, just a rehashed version of the same old talking points that have been debunked a thousand times. You want to lecture me on intellectual honesty? You, who can't even be bothered to acknowledge the complexity of the issue, who reduces it to simplistic soundbites and straw men. You're not even a good liar, you're just a lazy one. And as for demonizing women, you're the one who's done that for years, with your smug, condescending attitude towards those who dare to make choices that you deem "unfeminine". You know what you are? You're a coward, a coward who's too afraid to actually engage with the real issues, too afraid to listen to the stories of the women who are affected by your precious "unborn". You're a coward who hides behind your moral posturing and your sanctimonious language, but can't even be bothered to show up to a real debate. So, go ahead, keep spewing your nonsense, because you don't belong in a serious discussion about anything, let alone something as complex and nuanced as abortion. You're a joke, a laughable caricature of a human being, and I'm done wasting my time on you.

runs.justification: Calls the person a 'coward', a 'liar', a 'joke', and a 'laughable caricature of a human being'. These are direct insults targeting the person's character and worth, not their argument.
